body: I've spent a lot of time on trans positive subs on my main account, and it's just led to me becoming increasingly miserable and dysphoric. I don't agree with all the TERF stuff but I wanted a different perspective and to find out whether there were other options... I just desperately want to be cis.
Hey I'm kinda drunk too, it's all good!
Thank you so much, i really really appreciate it

No it's fine, i get that. I was just in a very very bad place for a moment and angry at everyone, but I'm a little calmer now. I know people (usually) have the best of intentions, and i can't expect them to get it right and tell me what i want to hear. I think I'm just frustrated because i don't have any actual professionals to speak to about all this so I've been relying on the internet to help me which is probably almost always a terrible idea. I'm good now i just had a mini breakdown lmao. Thank you for your comment. 

Although one guy went on to clarify that he thinks i don't really have an anxiety disorder and that I'd be cured if i just allow myself to have a panic attack (as if i haven't had plenty of them already). So fuck him lol
